# 1 Enoch Chapter 84 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Dreams

---

**1** And now, my son, I pray and implore you and request of you to do righteousness and uprightness upon the earth, so that judgment may come upon you, and the great judgment of all the world may not fall upon you finally; and that for you and your seed there may be mercy forever.

**2** For great is the Lord our God, great and mighty in His greatness, and great is His glory, and great is His mercy and compassion, and long-suffering is His forbearance. He will be with you and will not forsake you.

**3** But as for your heart, be mindful, O my son, not to conceal your sins from your God, and not to be proud before the Lord, and not to do evil before Him.

**4** And now let me show you, my son Methuselah, all my visions which I saw, for I will recount them before you.

**5** Two visions I saw before I took a wife, and they were quite different from each other. And I made petition to the Lord in regard to them.

**6** Blessed be the Lord, King of greatness and glory, who created the whole world, who is mighty in power over everything — King of kings, and God of gods, and Lord of lords — over all thrones of glory and kingdoms, and over all the Watchers and all the Governors; who orders and arranges all things, who gives wisdom to the wise and understanding to the understanding, who gives instruction and power to all people, and who rules over all. The King of kings, whose power is in heaven, who rules over the world of the earth as He wills —

**7** no one can withstand His power, and not one can escape His will, nor is there anyone before Him who can say "Nay." He is the King, the Lord, and none can escape before Him, and from His judgment there is no escape; before His majesty none can stand.

**8** The whole world He created by His power, and He knows all things from of old, and His power has been with Him from the beginning; and therefore He has written all things for us in the tablets of heaven.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Ge'ez text. Chapter 84 contains Enoch's great doxology — one of the finest prayers in 1 Enoch. The divine epithets 'King of kings, God of gods, Lord of lords' echo Daniel 2:47 and Deuteronomy 10:17. The prayer closes with the heavenly tablets, connecting this to chapters 81 and 103-104.*
